# Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository guidance in [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Additional project-specific defaults:

- Treat this repository as a Python project.
- Use the local virtual environment in `.venv/` when running Python commands or tests.
- Keep core application code in a dedicated package such as `src/` or `flipper_agent/`.
- Use `pytest` for tests and keep them under `tests/`.
- Update the dependency manifest (`pyproject.toml`, `requirements.txt`, or equivalent) when adding packages.
- Refer to [../README.md](../README.md) for the project purpose and high-level context.
